pictures.author: ZemplinTemplar
pictures.notes: Actually viewed top and bottom. Restored pale beige/plaster square tower; broad horizontal floor bands; small single openings below tall round-arched upper belfry windows; roundel/decorative frieze at eave; steep flared pyramidal dark red-brown tiled roof with gilt ball/thin iron finial. Low open round-arched arcade/red-brown roofs and two rounded corner projections flank a taller central decorated portal. Temporary restoration fence partly hides the base; omit that fence and copied relief/text.

pictures.author: ZemplinTemplar
pictures.notes: Actually viewed whole image across two viewport positions. Confirms steep flared pyramidal roof with a small dark vent, narrow gilt-ball/iron finial, pale restored body and open dark upper arch. The large ornate bulbous/clock-tower roof belongs to the separate cathedral on the right, not St Urban Tower. Bare branches obscure some lower detail; preserve the independent cathedral and trees as host context.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific restored St Urban Tower in Kosice: pale-plaster square body/floor bands, small closed windows, genuinely open round-arched upper belfry, simple original roundel frieze, steep flared pyramidal brown tiled roof/vent/gilt ball/iron finial, low open round-arched arcade with two rounded western corners/red-brown roofs and selected central portal relief. Existing shared low-frequency stucco/stone/roof/paint graphs; no copied epitaphs, heraldry, inscriptions, photographs, museum interior, temporary restoration fence, neighboring cathedral or whole square platform.
